agentic_ttt.title: Learn from what is new.
agentic_ttt.solution: Downweight repeated token patterns and update a lightweight adapter during interaction.
agentic_ttt.solutionZh: 对重复词元模式降权，在交互中更新轻量适配器。
agentic_ttt.challenge: How can an agent learn during a task without reinforcing its own mistakes?
agentic_ttt.challengeZh: 如何在任务中持续学习，又不反复强化自身错误？

mmg2skill.title: Turn guides into evolving skills.
mmg2skill.titleZh: 让指南成为可进化的技能。
mmg2skill.solution: Compile human guides into executable skills, then revise them through trajectory analysis.
mmg2skill.solutionZh: 将人类指南编译为可执行技能，再依据执行轨迹进行修订。
mmg2skill.challenge: How can an agent turn informal advice into reliable action?
mmg2skill.challengeZh: 智能体如何把非结构化经验转化为可靠行动？

webcompass.title: Test the website by using it.
webcompass.titleZh: 通过实际使用评测网站。
webcompass.solution: Evaluate generation, editing and repair through browser interaction and targeted checklists.
webcompass.solutionZh: 结合浏览器交互与针对性检查，评测生成、编辑与修复。
webcompass.challenge: Does the website actually work beyond its screenshot?
webcompass.challengeZh: 网站除了截图好看，是否真的可以正常使用？

color.title: Align detail with structure.
color.titleZh: 让细节与结构保持一致。
color.solution: Combine spectrally colored noise, Sobolev geometry and adversarial structural negatives.
color.solutionZh: 结合频谱有色噪声、Sobolev 几何与针对结构错误的对抗负样本。
color.challenge: How can generated detail remain faithful to the input?
color.challengeZh: 如何让生成的细节忠于输入结构？

tta_flow.title: Refine restoration at inference.
tta_flow.titleZh: 在推理过程中细化恢复。
tta_flow.solution: Fuse multimodal conditions and use reward feedback to guide training-free test-time refinement.
tta_flow.solutionZh: 融合多模态条件，以奖励反馈引导无需额外训练的测试时细化。
tta_flow.challenge: Can extra inference compute improve a difficult restoration?
tta_flow.challengeZh: 增加推理计算，能否改善困难样本的恢复效果？

shiftlut.title: Give lookup tables a wider view.
shiftlut.solution: Learn spatial shifts, allocate asymmetric branches and compress tables with bounded error.
shiftlut.solutionZh: 学习空间偏移，采用非对称分支，并在误差约束下压缩查找表。
shiftlut.challenge: How can lightweight lookup tables capture more spatial context?
shiftlut.challengeZh: 轻量查找表如何获取更丰富的空间上下文？

instantvir.title: Distill a prior into one pass.
instantvir.titleZh: 将生成先验蒸馏为一次前向。
instantvir.solution: Transfer a bidirectional diffusion teacher into a causal student with efficient latent processing.
instantvir.solutionZh: 将双向扩散教师蒸馏为因果学生，并提高潜空间处理效率。
instantvir.challenge: How can diffusion-based video restoration run in real time?
instantvir.challengeZh: 如何让基于扩散的视频恢复达到实时速度？

varsr.title: Build detail scale by scale.
varsr.solution: Condition autoregressive scales on low-resolution tokens and refine quantization residuals.
varsr.solutionZh: 以低分辨率词元约束逐尺度自回归生成，再细化量化残差。
varsr.challenge: How can autoregressive generation preserve the observed image?
varsr.challengeZh: 自回归生成如何保持与观测图像的一致性？

tinvblocks.title: Keep what reconstruction needs.
tinvblocks.titleZh: 保留重建真正需要的信息。
tinvblocks.solution: Separate luminance, chrominance and high frequencies in a tri-branch invertible block.
tinvblocks.solutionZh: 用三分支可逆模块分别处理亮度、色度与高频信息。
tinvblocks.challenge: What should a smaller image retain for faithful recovery?
tinvblocks.challengeZh: 小图应保留什么信息，才能支持忠实重建？

oapt.title: Recover the compression history.
oapt.solution: Predict JPEG-grid offsets and group matching artifact patterns for attention.
oapt.solutionZh: 预测 JPEG 网格偏移，并按伪影模式组织注意力。
oapt.challenge: How do we remove artifacts from misaligned double JPEG compression?
oapt.challengeZh: 如何去除网格错位的双重 JPEG 压缩伪影？

cpga.title: Use the codec's own clues.
cpga.titleZh: 利用编码器自身的线索。
cpga.solution: Guide temporal and spatial aggregation with motion, prediction and residual information.
cpga.solutionZh: 利用运动、预测与残差信息，引导时空特征聚合。
cpga.challenge: How can compressed video reveal the detail it has lost?
cpga.challengeZh: 如何利用压缩视频已有的信息恢复丢失的细节？

xpsr.title: Let semantics guide detail.
xpsr.solution: Fuse cross-modal semantic priors while suppressing degradation in conditioning features.
xpsr.solutionZh: 融合跨模态语义先验，同时抑制条件特征携带的退化。
xpsr.challenge: How can language help restoration without copying input degradation?
xpsr.challengeZh: 语言如何辅助恢复，同时避免输入退化继续传播？

ptmvqa.title: Bring diverse knowledge to quality.
ptmvqa.titleZh: 汇聚多样知识，感知视频质量。
ptmvqa.solution: Align frozen pretrained representations in a shared quality-aware feature space.
ptmvqa.solutionZh: 将冻结的预训练表示对齐到统一的质量感知特征空间。
ptmvqa.challenge: Can existing visual models help when quality labels are scarce?
ptmvqa.challengeZh: 质量标注不足时，能否借助已有视觉模型？

cassr.title: Restore with a clearer reference.
cassr.titleZh: 以更清晰的参考引导恢复。
cassr.solution: Build a preliminary reference, then guide cascaded diffusion with both reference and input.
cassr.solutionZh: 先构建初步参考，再结合参考与原始输入引导级联扩散。
cassr.challenge: How can a generative prior stay connected to degraded image evidence?
cassr.challengeZh: 生成先验如何始终受到退化图像证据的约束？

magvortex.title: Resolve the forces behind splitting.
magvortex.titleZh: 解析磁通管分裂背后的作用力。
magvortex.solution: Use field-line geometry and direct simulations to examine magnetic–vortical interactions.
magvortex.solutionZh: 结合磁力线几何与直接数值模拟，研究磁场与涡旋的相互作用。
magvortex.challenge: When does an accompanying vortex suppress magnetic-tube splitting?
magvortex.challengeZh: 伴随涡旋何时会抑制磁通管的分裂？

magknot.title: Follow reconnection into knots.
magknot.titleZh: 沿重联过程追踪磁结形成。
magknot.solution: Track magnetic surfaces through successive reconnections, rotation and stretching.
magknot.solutionZh: 追踪磁曲面在多次重联、旋转与拉伸过程中的演化。
magknot.challenge: How can initially unknotted magnetic lines form increasingly complex knots?
magknot.challengeZh: 初始无结的磁力线如何形成越来越复杂的结？

vortex.title: Track surfaces with a virtual flow.
vortex.solution: Construct circulation-preserving virtual transport for eligible non-ideal flows.
vortex.solutionZh: 为满足条件的非理想流动构造保持环量的虚拟输运。
vortex.challenge: How can vortex surfaces be tracked when physical motion no longer preserves them?
vortex.challengeZh: 物理运动不再保持涡面时，应如何追踪它们？

kat-v25-dev.title: Make agentic coding accessible.
kat-v25-dev.titleZh: 开放长程智能体编程能力。
kat-v25-dev.solution: Release a text-only 35B-A3B sparse model refined through supervised learning and RL.
kat-v25-dev.solutionZh: 开放经监督学习与强化学习优化的纯文本 35B-A3B 稀疏模型。
kat-v25-dev.challenge: How can an open-weight model sustain reliable, long-horizon tool use?
kat-v25-dev.challengeZh: 开放权重模型如何支持可靠的长程工具调用？

kat-v25.title: Build the environments that teach.
kat-v25.titleZh: 构建能够支持学习的环境。
kat-v25.solution: Combine verified task construction, diverse workflows and specialist distillation.
kat-v25.solutionZh: 结合可验证任务构建、多样工具工作流与专家蒸馏。
kat-v25.challenge: How do we train coding agents across realistic, verifiable tasks?
kat-v25.challengeZh: 如何在真实且可验证的多样任务上训练编程智能体？

kat-v2.title: Specialize first. Then unify.
kat-v2.solution: Train five domain experts and distill their capabilities into a single coding model.
kat-v2.solutionZh: 训练五类领域专家，再将其能力蒸馏到统一编程模型。
kat-v2.challenge: How can one agent retain strengths across different tools and domains?
kat-v2.challengeZh: 一个智能体如何兼顾不同工具与领域的优势？

lpm.title: Restore detail across long videos.
lpm.titleZh: 在长视频中稳定恢复细节。
lpm.solution: Combine a spatial generative prior with temporal fusion and pyramid-guided inference.
lpm.solutionZh: 结合空间生成先验、时间融合与时间金字塔引导推理。
lpm.challenge: How can restored videos stay coherent as their duration grows?
lpm.challengeZh: 随着视频时长增加，如何保持恢复结果的时间一致性？
